description:
ONE market-pulse read across every subject type — a news + market lens on an asset, a theme/sector, a
    commodity, a bond/rate/curve, a macro dashboard, or your portfolio. Pick `kind`, put the subject in `target`.
    Replaces the per-type asset/theme/commodity/bond/macro/portfolio pulse tools.

context.description: asset only — OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — paste the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language: 'ขอราคาผลไม้ apple', 'compare Apple and Microsoft stock'). The server uses it to disambiguate which candidate each `ticker` entity means (the apple COMPANY vs the fruit COMMODITY; which Samsung). One context per call, shared by all tickers here.
context.title: Context

country.description: ISO-2 CSV. theme: nationality scope ('European'→'GB,DE,FR,IT,ES,NL,CH,SE'; 'Thai'→'TH'). asset/macro: optional. Ignored by commodity/bond/portfolio.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles. (asset only)
limit.title: Limit

target.description: The SUBJECT for `kind`. asset: a ticker/company NAME ('NVDA','Apple'; the server resolves it). theme: a sector/industry/theme in ENGLISH ('semiconductors','banks','AI') — put nationality in `country`, NOT here. commodity: a commodity in English ('gold','copper','crude oil') or a SYMBOL.COMM. bond: a country/tenor/rate ('US 10Y','JGB 2Y','SOFR','US yield curve'). macro: a dashboard scope ('economy','inflation','labor','consumer','housing','recession-risk'). portfolio: the numeric portfolio id (call list_portfolios first if unknown).
target.title: Target

top_n.description: portfolio only: how many top holdings to analyze (default 3, cap 5).
top_n.title: Top N

window.description: News-recency window: `7d`/`30d`/`90d`/`180d`/`1y` or `mtd`/`qtd`/`ytd`. Omit → a sensible default. (Price history is unaffected — this only scopes the NEWS lens.)
window.title: Window

name: pulse
title: Market Pulse
